pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark-pigmented regions with softened pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patches on the upper flank exhibit higher spatial area and more defined angularity compared to smaller, more fragmented patches on the lower neck and chest.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of thick, light-cream colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcated. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, providing clear topological separation between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, visible as a jagged 1D geometric contour against the sky and background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible as dark, high-contrast shapes perched on the ventral neck and lateral flank areas.
